profile.headline: Sr iOS Software Engineer at PayPal | US Permanent Resident | Ex-Apple, University of Southern California
profile.summary:
I am an experienced Software Engineer with a strong adoption in mobile programming (iOS & Android). I have different kinds of published apps in the App Store and Play Store. A software engineer with experience in both private and public sectors, and I have worked on some independent projects.

Besides mobile programming, I have a special interest in DSA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, embedded programming, clean architecture, software design patterns, software engineering, optimization, and UX.

positions.title: Research Assistant, USC Viterbi Sonny Astani Department of Civil & Environmental Engineering Lab
positions.description: Use Computer Vision-based approaches to automatize condition assessment of civil infrastructure systems.

positions.title: Research Assistant, USC Viterbi WiDeS Lab
positions.description: Investigate and develop mobile applications and a back-end system to keep track of the user's video streaming activity and geolocation.

positions.title: Master of Science in Computer Science
iOS Architect, iOS Tech Lead
positions.description:
Royal Caribbean Cruises LTD – Miami, FL
• Managed Royal Core and Fun team (Augmented Reality and Games as tech lead and team member to build and support Royal Caribbean app and extensions.
• Engineer AR iOS experiences using Apple’s ARKit, Vuforia, and Unity.
• Architecture solutions (Clean Architecture and MVP) and Software Development (analysis, design, implementation and testing), Analytics, UX, UI analysis, and implementation, design and build
services and model layers, framework versioning/delivery to Royal Caribbean app, translations, auto layout, and app distribution.
• Mentored Junior and Senior developers in software development process and best practices.

Disney Interactive – Glendale, Los Angeles, CA
• Develop, managed, distribute and maintain Disney World and Disneyland apps features: PhotoPass (photo gallery with different options for edition similar to Instagram), Disney Core (Create a common base UI and services layer for entire app) and Memory Maker (Payment, transactions, park ticketing and passes logic).
• Volunteer to improve face recognition algorithm, automated testing and UX.

United Airlines Houston, TX
• Analyzed, developed, maintained Pilot Mobile: a scheduling iPad app written in Swift for 20,000 pilots of United Airlines. Features are: current & upcoming flights organized in a full-screen dashboard, latest flight information available, vacations, airport door codes, arrival/departure times, flight plans, delay notifications, bulletins, flight crew information and more.

positions.locationName: Barcelona Area, Spain & México City, México
positions.description:
Development of multi-country applications for classified media industry. +25 millions of worldwide downloads in (Brazil, México, Spain, Portugal, Finland and Chile).
Onsite and remote collaboration between Schibsted's development groups in Europe and Latin America.
Customizing user experience and funtionality for Schibsted-Mexico's mobile application.
Development of the new generation of iOS Apps of Schibsted for the classified
media industry, created from scratch for iOS 7 and higher. Dealing with the
issues caused by managing several countries with the same platform.

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in iOS, OSX and Android platforms.
Developed mobile applications for clients with focus in different professional areas (magazines, games, trivias, geolocation, social networks, audio voice processing) and frameworks (tracking, monetizing and reporting mobile traffic) for iOS & Android platforms.

positions.title: Independent iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as an independent iOS developer for a short term project

E-mail business service iOS app based in a language called Priority Matrix, a propietary measurement system composed of five Priority Levels, which was implemented by tagging e-mails. Google API’s e-mail services were used.

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
Developed web applications using Java, Oracle, SQL, CSS and JSP.
Responsible of automatize processes using Java and Oracle.
Oracle Support and monitoring database resources using a SHH client (Putty).
